content.value_statement: API teams need repeatable coverage for common REST and GraphQL weaknesses. This skill provides a phased checklist for authentication, authorization, validation, rate limits, and reporting.
actual_capabilities: Structures API security reviews into discovery, authentication, authorization, validation, rate limit, GraphQL, and error handling phases.
Lists concrete checks for API keys, JWTs, OAuth2 flows, token expiration, and refresh tokens.
Covers authorization checks for object access, function access, roles, privilege escalation, and tenant isolation.
Includes GraphQL checks for introspection, query depth, query complexity, batch queries, and field suggestions.
Provides quality gates for endpoint coverage, vulnerability documentation, remediation, and final reporting.
limitations: Does not run scanners or send requests by itself.
Requires authorized test targets and valid testing scope.
Depends on separate skills or tools for fuzzing and automated scanning.
Does not provide exploit payload libraries or vulnerability proof automation.

use_cases.title: Review a New API Release
use_cases.description: Use the phases as a pre-release checklist for authentication, authorization, validation, and error handling.

use_cases.title: Assess GraphQL Exposure
use_cases.description: Plan checks for introspection, query depth, query complexity, batching, and schema information leakage.

use_cases.title: Prepare Bug Bounty Testing
use_cases.description: Organize authorized API testing so findings are documented with impact, evidence, and remediation guidance.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic API Test Plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner planning for a known API scope.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an API security test plan for this authorized scope: [scope]. Cover discovery, authentication, authorization, validation, and reporting.

prompt_templates.title: Review Authentication Controls
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate review of tokens and login flows.
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me test API authentication for [system]. Include API keys, JWTs, OAuth2, token expiration, and refresh tokens.

prompt_templates.title: Map Authorization Test Cases
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced object and tenant access review.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design authorization tests for [API]. Include object access, function access, roles, privilege escalation, and tenant isolation.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Full API Audit Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a complete REST and GraphQL security workflow for [environment]. Include rate limits, input validation, GraphQL risks, error handling, and quality gates.

output_examples.input: Request a pre-release API security checklist for a payments service.
output: A phased checklist covering endpoint discovery, authentication, authorization, input validation, rate limiting, error handling, and reporting.
A set of quality gates for endpoint coverage, documented vulnerabilities, remediation notes, and final report readiness.

output_examples.input: Request GraphQL security testing guidance for an internal admin API.
output: A GraphQL review plan covering introspection, query depth, query complexity, batch queries, and field suggestion exposure.
A documentation outline for evidence, business impact, affected roles, and recommended fixes.

best_practices: Confirm written authorization and scope before testing any API.
Record tested endpoints, roles, tokens, expected results, and actual results.
Prioritize findings by impact, exploitability, affected users, and remediation effort.
anti_patterns: Do not test production APIs without approval and rate limits.
Do not assume authentication testing proves authorization is correct.
Do not report scanner output without manual validation and business impact.

faq.question: Does this skill execute security tests automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides a structured workflow and checklist for authorized API security testing.

faq.question: Can I use it with REST and GraphQL APIs?
faq.answer: Yes. The workflow includes phases for REST endpoints and GraphQL-specific risks.

faq.question: Does it require other tools?
faq.answer: Automated scanning and fuzzing require separate tools or skills. This skill coordinates the workflow.

faq.question: Is this suitable for bug bounty work?
faq.answer: Yes, when the program scope allows API testing and you follow the program rules.

faq.question: What security areas does it cover?
faq.answer: It covers discovery, authentication, authorization, input validation, rate limiting, GraphQL, error handling, and reporting.

faq.question: Does it include exploit payloads?
faq.answer: No. It focuses on test planning, coverage, documentation, and quality gates.
